n: DM NAX® Audio-over-IP Wall Plate with Bluetooth® Audio Support (DM-NAX-BTIO-100-1G)
d: DM-NAX-BTIO-100-1G DM NAX® Audio-over-IP Wall Plate with Bluetooth® Audio Support, Analog Audio Input and Output, 1-Gang

specs.label: Audio input signal types
specs.value: Unbalanced stereo analog line-level; Stereo Bluetooth wireless; DM NAX/AES67 audio-over-IP

specs.label: Audio output signal types
specs.value: Unbalanced stereo analog line-level; Stereo Bluetooth wireless; DM NAX/AES67 audio-over-IP

specs.label: S/N Ratio (at line-level output)
specs.value: From line-level input: 108 dB, 20 Hz to 20 kHz, A‑weighted; From digital input: 111 dB, 20 Hz to 20 kHz, A‑weighted

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: For control and PoE, AoIP, and/or console, 100/1000 Mbps, auto-switching, auto-negotiating, auto-discovery, full/half duplex, DHCP

specs.label: Bluetooth
specs.value: As receiver: Bluetooth 5.4 sink device, recalls up to seven previously paired devices, persistent or nonpersistent pairing, exclusive, interrupting, or temporary connection modes; Maximum Simultaneous Connections: 1 acti
